Criterion (per task): all hidden gold PR tests pass; no pass-rate criterion stated for a configuration. Values: pass rate over 3 repeats per task; Codex borderline subset (4 tasks) in brackets. No absolute cost totals are reported for any configuration (efficiency only as paired within-task tests; Claude capped at $6/run), so cost is 'not reported' except the exploratory opshin values.
- NONE + Claude Code (CLI, --bare) + claude-sonnet-4-6 (baseline): 53.3% (24/45); opshin (exploratory): duration 2,689 s, 3.67 blind full-suite runs per cell. Quality: no criterion stated by the authors; cost: not reported
- ALWAYS ON + Claude Code + claude-sonnet-4-6: 55.6% (25/45); opshin: 2,066 s, 2.44 full-suite runs. Quality: no criterion stated by the authors; cost: not reported
- SELECTIVE + Claude Code + claude-sonnet-4-6: 55.6% (25/45); cache-creation tokens lower than NONE on 11/11 tasks (p_Holm=0.012); opshin: 2,032 s, 1.67 full-suite runs. Quality: no criterion stated by the authors; cost: not reported
- NONE + Codex CLI + gpt-5.5 (baseline): 58.8% (30/51) [58%]. Quality: no criterion stated by the authors; cost: not reported (tool calls 32/32/32 across strategies, output tokens and duration within ±3.8%)
- ALWAYS ON + Codex CLI + gpt-5.5: 56.9% (29/51) [42%]. Quality: no criterion stated by the authors; cost: not reported
- SELECTIVE + Codex CLI + gpt-5.5: 52.9% (27/51) [42%]. Quality: no criterion stated by the authors; cost: not reported
- Probe (2 near-miss tasks, 36 cells): Codex 0/3 for all strategies on both tasks; Claude task 907 2/3 (NONE), 1/3 (ALWAYS ON), 0/3 (SELECTIVE), task 554 0/3 all
fields.why: Rule 1: 'partly' for 53-59% pass rates was the extractor's cut-off; the authors give a per-task pass criterion but none for a configuration. All values kept.

fields.doubt: Yes é defensável (resultados nulos com ressalvas de potência), mas a contribuição 3 e a conclusão dizem que a dificuldade específica do agente 'explica' as contradições, com base em 4 tarefas. Decide entre Yes e Partly.

O autor é independente dos fornecedores dos agentes, mas a estratégia SELECTIVE é construção sua (p. 9, limitação 5) e é avaliada. Decide se conta como abordagem própria (Partly) ou só condição experimental (Yes).
